description: This file contains the implementation of the WebChatManager class responsible for managing chat session windows and panels within a macOS application, including showing, toggling, and closing chat UI components, and handling their visibility states.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can accept key focus for typing purposes.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum representing the presentation style of the chat UI, either as a window or panel with an anchor provider.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing chat sessions through windows and panels, providing methods to show, toggle, close, and reset chat UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a chat window for the given session key, creating and configuring a new window controller if necessary.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a chat panel for the specified session key, creating and presenting it anchored if needed.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the chat panel if it is open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the preferred session key, caching the result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Closes and resets all chat session controllers, clearing cached session keys.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all chat session windows and panels.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Internal method called when the panel is hidden to notify about visibility change.
